lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct white vertical stripes are visible. Spacing is irregular, with a wider gap in the center of the torso and higher density clustering toward the posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is present on the 5th stripe from the posterior, occurring in the upper dorsal third of the torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 1st, 2nd, and 10th stripes (counting from posterior) are abbreviated, terminating mid-torso without extending to the ventral region.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density cluster of 4 high-contrast white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch, ventral to the primary vertical stripe field.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a 65-degree posterior-upward vector from the skull base, transitioning into a medial lyrate inward curve toward the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between apical tips is approximately 1.6 times the pixel width of the combined horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 12% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white spots are located on the cheek area; a transverse white band is visible on the bridge of the nose; a white dorsal crest of hair extends along the spine.
